abstract: Testicular carcinoma metastatic to the neck is rare. Even more rare is a finding of choriocarcinoma as a neck mass without any sign of a primary testicular tumor, as only a few cases have been reported in the literature. We describe a new case that occurred in a 29-year-old man who presented with a neck mass. Fine-needle aspiration biopsy identified the tumor as a malignant epithelial neoplasm. Radiologic findings indicated the presence of a systemic metastasis of a tumor to the chest and abdomen, as well as the neck. Findings on an incisional biopsy of the neck mass were consistent with a choriocarcinoma. The testicles were normal on palpation and ultrasonography. The patient was diagnosed with metastatic choriocarcinoma with an unknown primary, and he was started on chemotherapy. On the second day of treatment, which was 25 days after his referral to our clinic, he died of respiratory insufficiency.
abstract_ja: 精巣癌の頸部転移は稀である。精巣原発の所見がなく頸部腫瘤として絨毛癌が認められる例はさらに稀で、文献上も数例の報告しかない。今回、頸部腫瘤を主訴とした29歳男性の新たな症例を報告する。穿刺吸引生検では悪性上皮性腫瘍と判定された。画像所見では胸腹部を含む全身性転移を示唆した。頸部腫瘤の切開生検では絨毛癌と一致する所見が得られた。精巣は触診および超音波検査で正常であった。原発不明の転移性絨毛癌と診断され化学療法を開始したが、紹介から25日後、治療2日目に呼吸不全で死亡した。
